pr_title: arch: common: timing: Fix timing cycles 32bit rollover
pr_body:
Fix arch_timing_cycles_get() to prevent overflow on 32bit cycles rollover.

The issue is observable, for example when `tests/benchmarks/wait_queues` or `tests/benchmarks/sched_queues` are executed on qemu for `mps2/an385` and the benchmark has its iterations large enough as the default `BENCHMARK_NUM_ITERATIONS=1000`.

Fixes #84051

similar results for `mps2/an521/cpu0`

review_comments: why limited to uint32? the timing_t may be uint64_t

> why limited to uint32? the timing_t may be uint64_t

`arch_timing_counter_get()` is already 32bit here (`k_cycle_get_32()`)  isn't it ?

k_cycle_get_32() may need change to k_cycle_get_64(), which seems not right
```
if(NOT CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS AND
    NOT CONFIG_SOC_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS AND
    NOT CONFIG_BOARD_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS)
zephyr_library_sources_ifdef(CONFIG_TIMING_FUNCTIONS timing.c)
endif()
```
yeah, it should be better to have ifdefed 32/64 bit variants. i'll try to change both these functions this way.
